newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs seen capped as Bunds hit 101 resistance.
newsitem.headline: OLOs seen capped as Bunds hit 101 resistance.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures on Monday ended off session highs, in line with German Bund futures which bounced off strong resistance at the 101 level.
Dealers said that a further rise of OLOs would depend on whether Bund futures managed to break above resistance on Tuesday. OLO futures closed 96 bp higher at 120.95, after rising to 121.21.

Bund futures stood 73 bp higher at 11.80 by 1700 GMT, off their 100.96 session high. The 101 level has been visited twice in December, and once broken broken on intraday basis, but not on closing basis.

Dealers are eagerly awaiting Tuesday's OLO exchange auction for a first indication of Treasury funding needs. The state's cash needs have been relatively low in recent months, due to the austerity drive for the single currency.
Most dealers did not expect that tomorrow's auction would have influence on the 10-year OLO yield premium over Germany, which narrowed to eight bp from 12 today.
Monday's rally cut the 3-month/10 year yield differential 18 bp to 289 bp but the shape of the OLO curve did not move much.
-- Geert De Clercq, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6813, Fax +32 2 230 7710
